Chapter 10.3, Determination of Water and Sediment in Crude Oil by the Centrifuge Method (Laboratory Procedure), First Edition, April 1981 (ANSI/ ASTM D 4007)(IP 359)

This publication describes the method of laboratory determination of water and sediment in crude oil by means of the centrifuge procedure. 15 pages.

Price each, $5.00
